name: tree-public-bits-to-binders-zero-interface-sequence
hypothesis: More than half of discovery Boltz ipSAE values are exactly zero. Resolve that measurement-floor regime with sequence plausibility using a fixed 9:1 interface-to-ESM2 average (scores at most 0.1 on this branch), while retaining baseline ordering for positive interface scores. This tests a conservative sequence fallback instead of global mixing; weights are not fitted.
